author: Netuxx
body:
While we wait for Avicore to load we make a little "party" on TS (ts.avicus.net)

I took some screenshots and i want to post them here, enjoy!

People there (After i joined)
Everyone with Interview rank xD


Nolan with all the Mod ranks


A guy with all the posible rank (I dunno who is him)


Everyone get Vip!


Why we need human Moderators if we got Animals?

#ModDog4Owner

World Leaders and presidents on Ts, they are talking in peace or... 3 World War D:


And finally some names in other Languages


That was all, thanks for reading and sorry for my bad english!
Cya later!
~Netox
